sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm looking online for luggage storage before my train.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got a suitcase, so I open the help chat.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, can I leave my suitcase here for the afternoon?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, let's check which option works for your bag.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'm looking at the small lockers online.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, check the maximum bag size first.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says the maximum height is forty centimeters, right?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and the maximum width is thirty centimeters.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Mine's sixty-five centimeters tall, so it won't fit.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We've got a luggage desk for larger bags.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I compare the options before choosing where to go.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I use the luggage desk instead?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, someone there will tag your bag.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is the desk in the same building as the lockers?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it's on the ground floor, beside the main entrance.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, can I download my booking after I pay?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, download it and keep it on your phone.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I show it offline when I drop off my bag?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, make sure the booking number is clear.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: What time do I need to pick it up?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The lockers stay open till nine, but the desk shuts at six thirty.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what time does the luggage desk close?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Six thirty, so come back before then.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I check the pickup time against my travel plans.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll pick it up at six, before my train leaves.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That works, bring the bag tag back with you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I check the width of my suitcase there too?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, but your bag's too tall for our small lockers.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Right, I'll use the luggage desk and keep my tag safe.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Great, choose the luggage desk option when you book online.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll save my booking before heading out.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've checked the size limit, location, and latest pickup time.
